title: 💬 How to Contact Customer Service and Get Help Faster?
content:
If you need help with an order, payment, warehouse item, shipping parcel, customs issue, refund, or after-sales request, this guide will help you contact customer service more efficiently.

Providing clear information from the beginning can help us understand your issue faster and reduce back-and-forth communication.


🌟 Simple overview

When contacting customer service, please try to provide:

  1. Your order number
  2. Your parcel number, if available
  3. Your tracking number, if available
  4. Product link or screenshot
  5. Payment screenshot, if related to payment
  6. Photos or videos, if related to item or parcel problems
  7. A clear description of the issue
  8. Your preferred solution

The more complete your information is, the faster we can help.


1. 🧾 For order-related questions

If your question is about a shopping order, please provide your order number.

Order-related questions may include:

  • Order not purchased yet
  • Product out of stock
  • Price changed
  • Wrong color or size
  • Seller has not shipped
  • Order cancellation
  • Return or exchange request
  • Order status not updating

Please provide:

  • Order number
  • Product link or screenshot
  • Current order status
  • A short description of the issue
  • Your preferred solution

Example message:

“Hello, my order number is 123456. The status has been ‘Purchasing’ for 3 days. Could you please help me check whether the item has been purchased?”


2. 📦 For warehouse item questions

If your item has arrived at our China warehouse, please provide the order number or warehouse item number.

Warehouse-related questions may include:

  • Item not stored yet
  • Warehouse photo issue
  • Quantity mismatch
  • Wrong item received
  • Damaged item
  • Extra photo request
  • Repacking request
  • Return or exchange request

Please provide:

  • Order number
  • Warehouse item number, if available
  • Warehouse photo, if available
  • Description of the problem
  • What you want us to check or do

Example message:

“Hello, my item has arrived at the warehouse, but the color looks different from what I ordered. My order number is 123456. Could you please help me confirm with the seller?”


3. 🚚 For international parcel questions

If your question is about international shipping, please provide your parcel number.

Parcel-related questions may include:

  • How to submit a parcel
  • Shipping fee question
  • Parcel waiting for packing
  • Parcel not shipped yet
  • Wrong shipping address
  • Tracking not updating
  • Parcel delayed
  • Delivery failed
  • Parcel damaged or lost

Please provide:

  • Parcel number
  • Tracking number, if available
  • Destination country
  • Current parcel status
  • Screenshot of the issue, if available
  • A clear description of your question

Example message:

“Hello, my parcel number is P123456. It has been in ‘Packing’ status for several days. Could you please help me check when it will be shipped?”


4. 🌍 For customs or tax questions

If your parcel is in customs clearance or you received a notice from customs or the local courier, please provide the notice screenshot.

Customs-related questions may include:

  • Customs clearance delay
  • Tax payment request
  • ID or tax number request
  • Invoice or proof request
  • Parcel held by customs
  • Parcel returned by customs

Please provide:

  • Parcel number
  • Tracking number
  • Destination country
  • Customs or courier notice screenshot
  • Requested documents, if mentioned
  • Your question or concern

Example message:

“Hello, my parcel is in customs clearance. The local courier asked me to provide a tax ID. My tracking number is ABC123. Could you please help me understand what I need to do?”


5. 💳 For payment or balance questions

If your question is about payment, recharge, balance, or refund, please provide payment details.

Payment-related questions may include:

  • Payment failed
  • Payment completed but order still unpaid
  • Recharge not received
  • Balance not updated
  • Refund not received
  • Duplicate payment
  • Payment amount question

Please provide:

  • Order number or recharge record number
  • Payment amount
  • Payment time
  • Payment method
  • Payment screenshot
  • Transaction ID, if available
  • A short description of the issue

Example message:

“Hello, I paid $100 through PayPal, but my order still shows unpaid. My order number is 123456. Here is my payment screenshot. Could you please help me check?”


6. 🔄 For return, refund, or after-sales questions

If you want to cancel, return, exchange, or request a refund, please contact us as early as possible.

After-sales questions may include:

  • Cancel order
  • Return item
  • Exchange item
  • Wrong item
  • Damaged item
  • Missing item
  • Refund request
  • Parcel damage claim
  • Parcel loss claim

Please provide:

  • Order number
  • Parcel number, if related to international shipping
  • Product link or screenshot
  • Photos or videos of the issue
  • Reason for the request
  • Your preferred solution

Example message:

“Hello, I would like to return this item because the size is wrong. My order number is 123456. Could you please help me check whether the seller accepts returns?”


7. 📷 When should I send photos or videos?

Photos and videos are very helpful for item and parcel issues.

Please send photos or videos when:

  • The item looks wrong
  • The item is damaged
  • The quantity is incorrect
  • The package is damaged
  • Items are missing after delivery
  • You need to prove the condition of the parcel
  • You are applying for compensation

Useful photos include:

  • Product photo
  • Warehouse photo
  • Outer package photo
  • Inner package photo
  • Shipping label photo
  • Damaged area photo
  • All items received
  • Unboxing video, if available

For damaged or missing items, please keep all packaging materials until the issue is resolved.


8. 📝 How to describe your issue clearly

A clear message helps us understand your problem faster.

You can use this format:

  1. My order number / parcel number is:
  2. My current problem is:
  3. The current status is:
  4. I have already checked or tried:
  5. I would like to:

Example:

“My parcel number is P123456. The tracking has not updated for 10 days. The current status says ‘In Transit.’ I have checked the tracking page, but there is no new update. Could you please help me check with the logistics provider?”


9. ⏳ Why some issues take longer to solve

Some questions can be answered quickly. Others may take longer because we need to check with other parties.

For example:

  • Purchasing issues may require confirmation from the Chinese seller
  • Warehouse issues may require warehouse staff to check the item
  • Logistics issues may require feedback from the shipping provider
  • Customs issues may depend on local customs or courier processing
  • Refund issues may depend on the seller, payment provider, or bank
  • Damage or loss claims may require investigation and proof

We will update you when there is new information.


10. ⚠️ Please avoid sending repeated requests

To help us process your issue efficiently, please avoid sending the same question many times through different channels.

Repeated requests may slow down processing because support agents need to check duplicate messages.

If you already submitted a request, please keep the same conversation and wait for the next update.


11. ✅ Best time to contact us

Please contact customer service as soon as possible if:

  • You want to cancel an order
  • You selected the wrong size, color, or quantity
  • You entered the wrong shipping address
  • The warehouse photo shows a problem
  • You received a customs notice
  • Your parcel was delivered damaged
  • Items are missing after delivery
  • You need to submit a return or refund request

Some problems are easier to solve before the item is purchased, packed, or shipped internationally.


12. 📌 What customer service can help with

Customer service can help you:

  • Understand how to use the website
  • Check order status
  • Confirm product or seller issues
  • Explain fees
  • Guide you through parcel submission
  • Suggest suitable shipping methods
  • Check warehouse problems
  • Assist with return or exchange requests
  • Help communicate with logistics providers
  • Explain customs or tax notices
  • Assist with refund or after-sales requests


13. 🚫 What customer service cannot guarantee

We will do our best to help, but some results depend on sellers, logistics providers, customs, or payment channels.

Customer service cannot always guarantee:

  • The Chinese seller will accept cancellation
  • The seller will accept return or exchange
  • Customs will release the parcel immediately
  • No customs duties or taxes will be charged
  • Logistics tracking will update every day
  • Delivery will never be delayed
  • Compensation will always be approved
  • Payment provider fees will be refunded

We will help you check the available solution based on the actual situation.


Common message templates

You can copy and edit the templates below when contacting us.

🛒 Order status question

“Hello, my order number is ______. The current status is ______. Could you please help me check the latest progress?”

💳 Payment issue

“Hello, I paid ______ on ______ using ______. My order/recharge still shows unpaid or not received. Here is my payment screenshot. Could you please help me check?”

📦 Warehouse issue

“Hello, my order number is ______. The warehouse photo shows ______. Could you please help me confirm the issue?”

🚚 Shipping question

“Hello, my parcel number is ______. I want to ship it to ______. Could you please help me check which shipping method is suitable?”

🌍 Customs issue

“Hello, my tracking number is ______. Customs or the local courier asked me to provide ______. Could you please help me understand what I should do?”

🔄 Return or refund request

“Hello, I would like to request a return/refund for order ______ because ______. Could you please help me check whether it is possible?”

💥 Damaged parcel

“Hello, my parcel number is ______. The parcel arrived damaged. I have attached photos of the outer package, inner package, shipping label, and damaged item. Could you please help me submit a claim?”


Important notes

  • Please provide your order number or parcel number whenever possible.
  • For payment issues, please provide a payment screenshot.
  • For item issues, please provide product photos or warehouse photos.
  • For parcel damage or missing items, please provide photos or videos as soon as possible.
  • For customs issues, please provide the customs or courier notice.
  • Please describe the problem clearly and tell us what solution you prefer.
  • Contact us early if you need to cancel, return, modify, or correct information.
  • Some issues may require time because we need to check with sellers, warehouses, logistics providers, customs, or payment channels.


Frequently Asked Questions

Q1: I do not have an order number. Can you still help?

Yes. Please provide your registered email, product link, payment screenshot, or any related screenshot. We will try to locate the order.

Q2: Can customer service help me choose a shipping method?

Yes. Please provide your destination country, item type, estimated weight, delivery time requirement, and budget. We can give you a suggestion based on available shipping methods.

Q3: Why do I need to provide screenshots?

Screenshots help us verify payment, order status, product details, warehouse issues, logistics notices, or customs messages more quickly.

Q4: Can I contact customer service after my parcel is delivered?

Yes. If there is any issue after delivery, please contact us as soon as possible. For damaged or missing items, please provide photos or videos and keep all packaging materials.

Q5: Why does logistics investigation take time?

Logistics issues may involve multiple parties, such as the warehouse, shipping provider, airline, customs, transit center, and local courier. Investigation time depends on the logistics provider.

Q6: Can customer service cancel my parcel after it has shipped?

Usually no. Once a parcel has been handed over to the logistics provider, cancellation or address changes may not be possible.


Need help?

If you need assistance, please contact our customer service team through the official support channel on our website.

To help us assist you faster, please include:

  • Order number
  • Parcel number
  • Tracking number
  • Product link or screenshot
  • Payment screenshot, if related
  • Photos or videos, if related
  • A clear description of the issue
  • Your preferred solution

We will review your case and help you with the next step.
